gloss: advance payment received; deposit taken in advance

definitions.explanation: Money collected from a customer before the goods are delivered or the service is performed. It counts as a liability until the work is done, because the business still owes something in return.

examples.japanese: {前受金|まえうけきん}を{受|う}け{取|と}った。
{工事|こうじ}の{着手前|ちゃくしゅまえ}に{前受金|まえうけきん}をいただいています。
examples.english: We receive an advance payment before construction begins.

examples.japanese: {前受金|まえうけきん}は、{商品|しょうひん}を{渡|わた}した{時点|じてん}で{売上|うりあげ}に{振|ふ}り{替|か}える。
examples.english: The advance payment is transferred to sales at the point the goods are handed over.

examples.japanese: {注文|ちゅうもん}が{取|と}り{消|け}された{場合|ばあい}、{前受金|まえうけきん}は{全額|ぜんがく}お{返|かえ}しします。
examples.english: If the order is cancelled, we will refund the advance payment in full.

notes:
Formed from {前|まえ} (beforehand) + {受|う}け (receiving) + {金|きん} (money). Common in construction, custom manufacturing, and subscription businesses, where payment routinely comes before delivery.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {前受金|まえうけきん}を{受|う}け{取|と}る: to receive an advance payment
- {前受金|まえうけきん}を{返金|へんきん}する: to refund an advance payment
- {前受金|まえうけきん}として{計上|けいじょう}する: to record as an advance received

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {前払金|まえばらいきん}: advance paid — the mirror image, money the business pays out early
- {手付金|てつけきん}: deposit — a smaller sum paid to secure a contract, often non-refundable
- {内金|うちきん}: part payment — a portion of the price paid up front
